_rule.statement: Code presence does not equal constitutional activation. Reserved-suite code may exist ONLY if: (1) recorded here; (2) NO active frontend dependency presents it as active; (3) NO active suite manifest presents it as active; (4) release canon marks it deferred; (5) the ratchet prevents growth. Do not let real code accidentally amend the Constitution.
